install:
set -euo pipefail
export FLEET_RM_ROOT="${FLEET_RM_ROOT:-$HOME/Repository_Management}"
if [ ! -f "$FLEET_RM_ROOT/scripts/cursor/bootstrap.sh" ]; then
  git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/D-sorganization/Repository_Management.git "$FLEET_RM_ROOT"
fi
bash "$FLEET_RM_ROOT/scripts/cursor/bootstrap.sh"
